description:
Enter Aniimo, a next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG where adventure is better together. Explore a vast and living world, discover and catch unique Aniimo, team up with other players, and jump into dynamic real-time battles.  

Aniimo is available now: https://epic.gm/aniimo

author: Epic Games
description:
Get a closer look at Kingmakers, the upcoming medieval action-strategy sandbox. 

In this Gameplay Deep Dive, the developers provide brand-new details on the game's story and key gameplay systems such as combat, settlement management, and RTS mechanics. 

Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in Kingmakers. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.

Wishlist now! https://epic.gm/kingmakers
